bento.heading: Engineering for Scale, Resilience & Transactional Integrity
bento.subheading: Over 5 years architecting high-concurrency REST APIs, fintech integrations, and robust web applications across Brazil, the US, and Switzerland.
bento.bioLead: I am a Full Stack Software Engineer focused on architecting resilient distributed systems, high-volume financial integrations, and modern frontend interfaces.
bento.bioP1: Throughout my career, I have specialized in the modern PHP ecosystem (Symfony and Laravel) and C# .NET 8 on the backend, paired with Vue.js 3, TypeScript, and Pinia on the client side. My work spans high-scale fintech solutions, healthcare ERPs, and multi-tenant SaaS products.
bento.bioP2: I bring international experience working remotely with distributed teams in the United States and Switzerland, always adhering to Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, and rigorous automated testing.
bento.pillar1Desc: Service Layers, Clean Architecture, and distributed locking with Redis to guarantee zero duplicate credits and exact-once delivery across +1M PIX transactions and webhooks.
bento.pillar2Desc: Domain logic covered with xUnit, Moq, PHPUnit, and Vitest. Predictable, repeatable deployments using Docker containers and automated CI/CD pipelines.
bento.pillar3Desc: Experience leading technical squads to digitize complex workflows (such as 11 interconnected hospital systems), eliminating manual paper forms and enforcing role-based access control (RBAC).

bento.heading: Engenharia focada em escala, resiliência e integridade transacional
bento.subheading: Mais de 5 anos projetando APIs REST de alta concorrência, integrações financeiras e plataformas web modernas no Brasil, EUA e Suíça.
bento.bioLead: Sou Engenheiro de Software Full Stack dedicado a construir sistemas distribuídos resilientes, integrações financeiras de alto volume e interfaces web modernas.
bento.bioP1: Ao longo da minha trajetória, especializei-me no ecossistema PHP moderno (Symfony e Laravel) e C# .NET 8 no backend, aliados a Vue.js 3, TypeScript e Pinia no frontend. Minha experiência abrange desde motores de liquidação de pagamentos até digitalização hospitalar e plataformas SaaS multi-tenant.
